name: positive-control-calculators-down
title: Positive control: Hermes without its calculator tools (A) vs the full toolset (B), all 21 tasks x 5
description: The validation run set out before it started (docs/experiment.md, Validation: a positive control). Arm A is Hermes with prompt v1 on Claude Haiku 5.5 with the 8 calculator tools removed (toolset finance-no-calculators/v3, for validation only); arm B is the same config with the full finance/v3 toolset. All 21 tasks x 5 trials. The platform had to find a large effect on the tasks that need a calculator and none on the controls, and did: B passes 65.7% against A's 20.9%, +44.8 points (95% interval +23.8 to +65.7), sign-flip p = 0.0011; 7 tasks flagged beyond noise, all among the 14 predicted, none of the 7 controls; the broken arm's primary cause is wrong tool in 68 of its 83 failed trials.
experiment_name: Positive control: calculators down (A) vs fixed (B), 21 tasks x 5
